{{Quest infobox | id = | image = [[File:War in Kryta 10.jpg|196px]] | campaign = War in Kryta | required = Eye of the North | region = Tarnished Coast | given by = [[Chark]] | given at = [[Arbor Bay]] | part of = [[The War in Kryta]] | preceded by = [[Zinn's Task]] or [[The Knowledgeable Asura]] | minimission = y | map = | map1text = Quest map. }} The [[Trial of Zinn]] is one part of the ''[[Guild Wars Beyond]]'' content. It takes place in an alternate version of [[Vlox's Falls]]. Speak with [[Chark]] outside [[Vlox's Falls]] to attend. Access to this trial requires completion of the quest [[Zinn's Task]] ''or'' completion of [[The Knowledgeable Asura]] portion of the Eye of the North campaign. You may also join the party of a player who has met those requirements. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== '''The [[Arcane Council]]:''' *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Councilor Lumpys]] *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Mamp|Councilor Mamp]] *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Councilor Mintoc]] *{{n}} 20 (20) [[Oola|Councilor Oola]] *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Councilor Troi]] *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Councilor Wrex]] '''The Persecution:''' *{{x}} 1 (20) [[Denn and Krayn]] '''The Defense:''' *{{d}} 20 (20) [[M.O.X.]] *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Zinn]] '''Witnesses:'''

Mark my words: This sentence is a greater punishment for you, who will be deprived of my genius, than it is for me, who will be freed from your ignorance."'' :'''Zinn:''' ''"In conclusion, let me paraphrase my great uncle Fenwikk: Fools! I'll show you all!"'' == Notes == * You do not need to unlock M.O.X. or include him in your party to access to this area, even though Chark's dialogue suggests otherwise. * It is possible to enter into areas not otherwise accessible. [[Return]] or similar [[Shadow Step]]s work well for this. ** You can explore [[Arbor Bay]] by jumping past the Golem sentries, allowing you to uncover areas near the portals to [[Shards of Orr]], [[Alcazia Tangle]], and [[Riven Earth]]. (You can use the same method to go beyond the portal to [[Vloxen Excavation]], but this area can be uncovered through normal game play.) ** You can reach the platform where the trial takes place. * Your character can return to this version of Vlox's Falls by joining a party that includes those witnessing the trial for the first time. * All [[Hero]]es and [[Henchmen]], as well as [[Ranger]] [[pet]]s will be removed from the party for the duration of the trial, but once you return to town, the ranger pet will return. == Trivia == * The punishment bears similarities to the practice of [[w:Ostracism|Ostracism]] in ancient Athens, in which citizens could be banished from the city for a period of ten years, during which retribution would be death. * The title "Intruder Zinn" is a reference to the show, [[w:Invader_Zim|Invader Zim]]. The show is also referenced by G.O.X., who says, ''"I AM GOING TO SING THE DHUUM SONG NOW..."'' * Several lines are from the movie ''[[w:A Few Good Men (film)|A Few Good Men]]'', such as Zinn's overly verbose paraphrasing of ''"You can't handle the truth!"'' as said by Jack Nicholson's character. * Councilor Troi's name and initial comments about ''"being taken more seriously with this new tunic"'' appears to be be a reference to the Marina Sirtis' wardrobe changes on early episodes of Star Trek: The Next Generation. * M.O.X.'s sentence : "If it does not comp-pute, you must ac-quit" refers to the infamous line from the trial of O.J. Simpson, ''"If that don't fit, you must acquit"''. * The Weapon Krewe Members talk about unleashing the Large Hydra Collider, a reference to the [[w:Large Hadron Collider|Large Hadron Collider]]. * Councilor Mintoc's name and comments are a reference to the television programme [[w:Harvey_Birdman,_Attorney_at_Law|Harvey Birdman, Attorney at Law]] and is based on the character [[w:Mentok_the_Mind-Taker| Mentok the Mind-Taker]] *Towards the end of the trial, Zinn protests: ''"I'm out of order? You're out of order! This whole trial is out of order!"'', which is is a common misquotation of the line from the film ''"[[w:...And Justice for All (film)|...And Justice for All]]"''. The actual quote is ''"You're out of order! You're out of order! The whole trial is out of order! They're out of order!"'' *After the trial, speaking to [[Councilor Mamp]] will have him reference two books: ''"Trial by Stone"'' and ''"To Kill a Moa Bird"''. The latter is a reference to the famous 1960 novel written by [[w:Harper Lee|Harper Lee]], ''"[[w:To Kill a Mockingbird|To Kill a Mockingbird]]"''.
